dagger.label: A dagger lies four grids away
dagger.explanation: A level-12 Warrior with a free pack slot sees a Dagger four grids east. The production Lunal take routine decides whether to go for it. Original: the routine marks the dagger bad (it is not gold, an artifact, a stat potion or a valuable start-of-game item) but never skips it, so the Borg flows to it. Corrected: the dagger is skipped and the routine does nothing.
